newsitem.title: USA: Arcadia adds $75 mln to credit line.
newsitem.headline: Arcadia adds $75 mln to credit line.

text.p: Arcadia Financial Ltd, which provides financing for new and used vehicles, said Tuesday it secured a $75 million increase to its existing $300 million credit agreement with Bank of America.

The larger $375 million facility is funded through commercial paper administered by Bank of America and will continue to finance the daily purchase of automobile receivables prior to securitization, Arcadia said in a news release.
This transaction, combined with an agreement renewed recently with J.P. Morgan, brings total funding commitments to about $650 million for the company.

"These renewed warehouse funding arrangements provide the company with additional capital to fund loan purchases and enhance the overall liquidity available to Arcadia," said Richard Greenawalt, Arcadia's president and chief executive officer.
